site.title: Gregorio Sigala
site.description: A navigable two-dimensional grid of projects, experiments, and coursework. Move between spaces with the arrow keys.

spaces.title: About
spaces.summary: Software engineer. This site is a grid you can walk around in; every space holds a project.
body: I build software, mostly in Dart, Python, C, and Java, and I like interfaces that behave like places rather than pages.
Everything here is a space on a two-dimensional grid. Arrow keys, WASD, or a swipe move you to the nearest space in that direction. Enter opens the space you are standing on.
Each space has a real URL, so anything you find here can be linked, shared, and read without JavaScript.

spaces.title: Spotify Visualizer
spaces.summary: A Spotify visualizer written in Flutter. Summer 2021.
body: A Flutter application that renders a visualization driven by Spotify playback data.
It was my first attempt at turning live audio state into something you can look at, and the origin of my interest in interfaces that respond continuously rather than on click.

spaces.title: gameEp
body: A Java game project from 2023, built around a small game loop and hand-rolled rendering.
Java is still where I go when I want strict types and a long-lived process.

spaces.title: Omok in Dart
spaces.summary: Omok, the board game known as five-in-a-row, implemented in Dart.
body: Omok implemented in Dart with a playable board and win detection.
Board games are a useful forcing function: the rules are exact, so the code has to be too.

spaces.title: Omok in PHP
spaces.summary: The same game, server-rendered in PHP for a web programming course.
body: A server-rendered take on Omok for a web programming course, where the board state lives in the request rather than in a client-side loop.
Useful contrast with the Dart version: same rules, completely different shape of code.

spaces.title: SLPB3
spaces.summary: A Python project in the SLP series.
body: Python work from the SLP project series.
Python is where I reach for quick tooling and data work.

spaces.title: SLP Final

body: The final project in the SLP series, where the earlier pieces were put together.

spaces.title: the_basics
spaces.summary: A basic website coded in Flutter.
body: An early exercise in shipping a website with Flutter web.
It aged into a good argument for plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript when the site is mostly text.

Coordinating a shared codebase is most of the work; the code is the easy part.
